about: In Eastertide, this pair of Alleluia verses replaces the gradual and tract for the Annunciation of the Blessed Virgin Mary.

s01.translation: Alleluia, alleluia. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee, blessed art thou among women. Alleluia. The shoot of Jesse has blossomed; the Virgin has borne God and man. God has restored peace, reconciling in Himself the things below with those above. Alleluia.

w056.explanation: The parallel clauses link the blossoming shoot with the Virgin bearing Christ.

w060.explanation: “God” and “man” describe the same child, Christ.

w070.explanation: The lower and upper extremes are brought together. The paired expressions speak of things below and above, without naming a particular group of people.
